blocks.prompt: 16 (a) Using a cryptographic system, a password is generated with 8 characters. Each character can either be a lowercase letter (a-f) or a digit (0-5). How many passwords can be generated if each password must contain exactly 5 lowercase letters and 3 digits? (a) With repetition allowed
blocks.explanation:
Password mein tarteeb ahem hai. Letters 6 hain (a se f) aur digits bhi 6 (0 se 5). Teen kaam hain: 8 khaanon mein se kaunse 5 letters ke liye hon, letters wale khaane bharna, aur digits wale khaane bharna.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{5} \times 6^{5} \times 6^{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 khaane; theek 5 letters \(\{a, \dots, f\}\) se aur 3 digits \(\{0, \dots, 5\}\) se; repetition allowed.
Humein find karna hai: passwords ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Teeno kaam ek saath hote hain, is liye fundamental principle of counting se multiply.

Letters ke khaane chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = {}^{8}C_{3} = 56\]
Kyun: 8 khaali khaane sochein. Kaunse 5 khaanon mein letters aayenge, yeh sirf khaanon ka group chunna hai (khaane 1, 3, 4, 7, 8 kisi bhi tarteeb mein bolein, group wahi hai), is liye combination. Baqi 3 khaane khud ba khud digits ke ho gaye.
Dhyan dein: Yeh qadam bhool jana (sirf letters pehle, digits baad mein maan lena) is sawal ki sab se bari ghalti hai.

Khaane bharein
\[\text{letters: } 6^{5} = 7776\]
\[\text{digits: } 6^{3} = 216\]
Kyun: Repetition allowed hai, is liye har letter wale khaane mein 6 choices aur har digit wale khaane mein bhi 6 choices, chahe pehle wahi letter ya digit aa chuka ho.

Multiply karein
\[7776 \times 216 = 1679616\]
\[56 \times 1679616 = 94058496\]
Kyun: Teen kaam saath hain, is liye zarb. Note karein ke \(7776 \times 216 = 6^{8}\), kyunke 8 khaanon mein har ek ke 6 options hain.

Tasdeeq
\[56 \times 6^{8} = 56 \times 1679616\]
\[= 83980800 + 10077696 = 94058496 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 56 ko \(50 + 6\) mein tora, dono hisse alag multiply kar ke jama kiye, wahi jawab aaya.

blocks.prompt: 16 (b) Using a cryptographic system, a password is generated with 8 characters. Each character can either be a lowercase letter (a-f) or a digit (0-5). How many passwords can be generated if each password must contain exactly 5 lowercase letters and 3 digits? (b) Without repetition.
blocks.explanation:
Part (a) wale hi teen kaam, lekin ab 5 letters sab mukhtalif aur 3 digits sab mukhtalif hone chahiye.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{5} \times {}^{6}P_{5} \times {}^{6}P_{3}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: part (a) jaisa, lekin koi letter ya digit dobara nahi aa sakta.
Humein find karna hai: passwords ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Khaane \({}^{8}C_{5}\) se; letters tarteeb ke saath baghair repetition \({}^{6}P_{5}\); digits tarteeb ke saath baghair repetition \({}^{6}P_{3}\). Letters aur digits ke liye permutation is liye ke khaanon mein un ki tarteeb password badal deti hai.

Letters ke khaane chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = 56\]
Kyun: Bilkul part (a) ki tarah; repetition ka is qadam se koi ta'alluq nahi.

Khaane bharein
\[{}^{6}P_{5} = 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 = 720\]
\[{}^{6}P_{3} = 6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4 = 120\]
Kyun: Pehle letter khaane mein 6 choices, agle mein 5 (kyunke ek letter use ho gaya), phir 4, 3, 2. Digits mein bhi isi tarah 6, 5, 4.

Multiply karein
\[720 \times 120 = 86400\]
\[56 \times 86400 = 4838400\]
Kyun: Teeno kaam saath hain, is liye zarb.
Dhyan dein: 86,400 par ruk jana ghalat hai; woh sirf "pehle 5 letters, phir 3 digits" wali ek tarteeb ginta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[86400 \times 56 = 86400 \times 50 + 86400 \times 6\]
\[= 4320000 + 518400 = 4838400 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 56 ko tor kar multiply karne par wahi jawab aaya. Aur yeh part (a) se chhota hai, jo hona hi chahiye kyunke repetition band karne se options kam hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (i) 86,400 aur (ii) 120 likhti hai. 86,400 \(= {}^{6}P_{5} \times {}^{6}P_{3}\) baghair repetition wali ginti hai jis mein letters aur digits ke khaane pehle se tay maan liye gaye: is mein letters ke khaane chunne ke \({}^{8}C_{5} = 56\) tareeqe shamil nahi, aur yeh 'with repetition' ke neeche likha hai. 120 kisi part ka jawab nahi. Sahi jawab: (a) 94,058,496; (b) 4,838,400.
